research_rationale: EO 5857 (June 16, 1932) amends the Consular Regulations of 1896: it cancels section 598, substitutes "Tariff Act of 1930" for the 1922 Act citation in sections 657, 668, 672, 674, 677, 679 and 686, rewrites section 662(b), changes the citation in section 663, amends section 682, and rewrites section 719. All are standing regulatory text, not one-time acts. EO 8818 (signed July 5, 1941; 6 FR 3313, July 9, 1941) amends the Foreign Service Regulations by prescribing chapter XV, Documentation of Merchandise (invoice certification and documentation for importation), cancels listed provisions, and under the heading "Revocation of Executive Orders" states "are hereby revoked:" and lists "Executive Order 5857, dated June 16," 1932. The revocation is an express act of the same order that replaces the documentation rules, not a general cleanup. No effective date is stated, so the date is the July 5, 1941 signing (filed July 7, published July 9). The only ending is EO 8818; the order's own terms contain no end (the Tariff Act text it cites is a statutory reference, not a duration). Not operative on 2026-10-14.
savings_reason: The EO 8818 text held contains no saving clause for the amendments revoked, and no held source shows a right, duty or transaction that survives from the cancelled or rewritten regulation sections; the amendments changed regulation text only.
earlier_end_check: Searched the held corpus for 'Consular Regulations of 1896' cancellation or replacement and for the number 5857: only EO 8818 (and its 1989 OFR editorial note) names it; no earlier revocation, supersession or own-terms end exists. The 1989 editorial note 'Revoked by EO 8818' agrees but is not relied on as the basis.
scope_check: EO 8818 revokes EO 5857 by name and date in full, with no partial scope; its revocation list names the order, not a part of it, so every clause is revoked together.
independent_command_check: All three clauses are amendments to regulation text and none is an independent command, report or delegation; the revocation in EO 8818 reaches each of them as part of the whole order.
savings_check: EO 8818 has no saving clause; nothing in the held texts preserves effects of the amendments after revocation.

research_rationale: EO 5866 (June 28, 1932) revokes the second paragraph of EO 3705-A and substitutes a paragraph fixing additional compensation of $5 to $1 per month (first to fifth class) for Marine Corps enlisted men qualified in the use of arms. It is a standing rule on pay. The Federal Register text of EO 9209 (7 FR 6029, August 5, 1942; signed August 1, 1942) states: "Executive Orders No. 3705-A of July 1," ... "and No. 5866 of June 28, 1932," ... "are hereby superseded." and "This order shall take effect as of June" ... "1, 1942." EO 9209 re-prescribes the same five classes and amounts. A held-corpus search for the number and for 3705-A found no earlier revocation, supersession or own-terms end; EO 5866 has no duration or condition clause. The order therefore ended on June 1, 1942, the effective date EO 9209 gives itself, and was not operative on 2026-10-14.
savings_reason: EO 9209 prescribes the same five classes of additional compensation at the same monthly amounts ($5.00, $4.00, $3.00, $2.00, $1.00) for qualified Marine Corps enlisted men, so the continuing entitlement passed to EO 9209 on its effective date; the EO 9209 text held contains no clause preserving or cancelling pay already earned under EO 5866, and no held source shows any other surviving effect.
earlier_end_check: Searched held texts for the number 5866 and for 3705-A (jobs/*/output/texts and jobs/fr-originals/data): only EO 9209, EO 9210 (Navy and Coast Guard sibling), the order itself and its APP/clause copies name it; no earlier revocation or supersession was found, and the order's own text has no term, condition or expiry.
scope_check: EO 9209 supersedes EO 5866 by number and date in a single express sentence, with no exception or partial scope; EO 5866 has one operative paragraph, so the whole order is superseded.
independent_command_check: EO 5866 contains a single command (the substituted paragraph of EO 3705-A); no independent command, reporting duty or delegation survives separately.
savings_check: EO 9209 carries the same rates and conditions forward from June 1, 1942; the EO 9209 text contains no savings clause for earlier accruals, and none is shown by a held source.
